title: Automate the complete UI to sync to downloaded-content flow
description:
Coverage gap identified during Astra review of main 3b2c4f5 against SPEC.md §11. This is a verification gap, rather than a separately reproduced product defect.

## Current coverage

server/e2e_test.go:47 polls the engine directly rather than observing /sync. Archive validation at line 68 checks only opening bytes. The browser portion is expressly manual at line 23. The repository therefore lacks a repeatable automated check of the full UI → API → realtime sync → retrieved-content contract.

Existing Go tests passed during review (cached results). Browser MCP access was denied, so no fresh browser or public-torrent E2E verification was performed.

## Acceptance criteria

- Run a built embedded binary against an isolated temporary configuration and download directory.
- Drive the actual Vue UI to add a legal pinned torrent fixture and observe metadata/progress and downloaded files through the real realtime connection.
- Retrieve a downloaded file and verify its content, not only response status or nonempty output.
- Download a directory ZIP, open it with an archive reader, and verify expected entries and content.
- Make the test reproducible through a Take command and document prerequisites, network gating, fixture provenance, and cleanup.
- Never touch the server's live downloads or configuration.

## References

SPEC.md §10 core flow and §11 testing strategy.
